en.title: 142 of 155 resorts in Norway have snow on top: the list
en.description: 142 of 155 resorts in Norway have snow on top: the list. Snow cover, new snow, resorts and the days ahead in Norway on 19 November.
en.lede: 142 of the 155 resorts in Norway have snow on their upper slopes today. Riksgränsen leads with 55 cm.

p: Snow on the upper slopes is not the same as open runs: lifts open when the base is deep enough to groom, and the resort decides that.
Snow covers roughly 250,530 km² in Norway on 19 November, little changed from yesterday. In other words, 89 % of the mapped high ground is white.
Riksgränsen leads with 167 cm on its upper slopes.
Close behind: Sulitjelma Fjellandsby (126 cm), Tromsø Alpinpark (91 cm), Galdhøpiggen Sommerskisenter (61 cm) and Steilia (59 cm).
Riksgränsen had no fresh snow in the last three days; 4 cm could fall by Sunday 22 November.
Sulitjelma Fjellandsby had no fresh snow in the last three days; 4 cm could fall by Sunday 22 November.
Snow lies on the upper slopes of 142 out of 155 resorts in Norway.

The rest of the shortlist: Tromsø Alpinpark: 91 cm on top, 6 cm in three days, 16 cm expected; Galdhøpiggen Sommerskisenter: 61 cm on top, 0 cm in three days, 7 cm expected; Steilia: 59 cm on top, 1 cm in three days, 4 cm expected.

sections.h: How deep it is, height by height
p: Climb and the snow gets deeper: between 0 and 500 m, 8 cm on average, 80 % covered; between 500 and 1,000 m, 18 cm on average, 95 % covered; between 1,000 and 1,500 m, 24 cm on average, 100 % covered; between 1,500 and 2,000 m, 28 cm on average, 100 % covered; between 2,000 and 2,500 m, 40 cm on average, 100 % covered.
Expect up to 24 cm on the snowiest slopes by the third day; the seven-day total reaches 33 cm.
Saturday 21 November stands out, with up to 12 cm in a day.
Further out, days 8 to 14 show up to 25 cm on the snowiest slopes.
Day by day, the white area in Norway went: 16 November 246,310 km²; 17 November 246,210 km²; 18 November 249,960 km²; 19 November 250,530 km².
Riksgränsen has been the deepest resort every day this week.
The new snow freshens the upper slopes; lower down it may already be heavy or wet.
Keep an eye on the forecast: the coming snow could change the picture quickly.
Snow lies right down to the lowlands and the coast. Over the week the white area has hardly moved from 250,760 km².

sections.h: New snow in the last three days
p: In the last 72 hours the most new snow, up to 13 cm, fell over the Lyngen Alps.
In the past day, up to 4 cm was added.
At least 5 cm fell over some 46,820 km².

Resort by resort, today against a normal 19 November: Riksgränsen: 55 cm at about 708 m, against 61 cm in a normal year; Sulitjelma Fjellandsby: 48 cm at about 465 m, against 52 cm in a normal year; Tromsø Alpinpark: 17 cm at about 222 m, against 38 cm in a normal year; Galdhøpiggen Sommerskisenter: 31 cm at about 2,015 m, against 84 cm in a normal year.
0 of these 4 resorts are above their usual depth for the date.
These depths are for one height on each mountain, below the top, so they read lower than the upper-slope numbers further down.
In past winters the best snow at Riksgränsen usually came early April / mid-April.

For comparison, the neighbours on the same day: Sweden: 87 % white, deepest Björkliden with 139 cm, up to 19 cm in the week ahead; Finland: 55 % white, deepest Salla with 25 cm, up to 13 cm in the week ahead.

sections.h: Planning a day on the snow
p: Above 0 m the ground is almost fully white (80 % covered), so runs up there have a continuous base.
If you can choose the day, go after Saturday 21 November: the fresh snow then has time to settle and the roads to be cleared.

advice: Fresh snow on a cold base sticks badly: take care on steep slopes.
Roads to the higher resorts may need winter tyres or chains.
Read the local avalanche bulletin before going off-piste.

nb.title: Snø i Norge i dag: snødybde og nysnø, 19. november 2026
nb.description: Snø i Norge 19. november: snødekke, nysnø, snødybde etter høyde, de neste dagene og de beste skistedene.
nb.lede: I Norge er rundt 250 530 km² snødekt i dag (torsdag 19. november). Arealet er nesten det samme som i går. Det er 89 % av området i Norge vi følger.

p: Snøen ligger helt ned til lavlandet og kysten. På en uke har arealet knapt endret seg fra 250 760 km².

Gjennomsnittlig snødybde etter høydelag: 0–500 m: i snitt 8 cm (80 % snødekt); 500–1 000 m: i snitt 18 cm (95 % snødekt); 1 000–1 500 m: i snitt 24 cm (100 % snødekt); 1 500–2 000 m: i snitt 28 cm (100 % snødekt); 2 000–2 500 m: i snitt 40 cm (100 % snødekt).
Mest nysnø siste 72 timer: opptil 13 cm. Områder: Lyngsalpene.
Bare det siste døgnet kom det opptil 4 cm.
Minst 5 cm nysnø dekker rundt 46 820 km².
Nysnø oppå grunnlaget gir myke svinger øverst; lenger ned er det flekkete.
Med mer snø i varselet bør de neste dagene bli bedre.
Mest snø i de øvre bakkene: Riksgränsen, 167 cm.
Skisteder med snø i de øvre bakkene: 142 av 155.
Deretter: Sulitjelma Fjellandsby (126 cm), Tromsø Alpinpark (91 cm), Galdhøpiggen Sommerskisenter (61 cm) og Steilia (59 cm).
Sulitjelma Fjellandsby: ingen nysnø på tre dager; innen søndag, 22. november kan det komme 4 cm.
De neste tre dagene ventes opptil 24 cm, og opptil 33 cm gjennom uka.
Den snørikeste dagen: lørdag, 21. november, opptil 12 cm.
Lenger fram, dag 8–14, kan de snørikeste fjellsidene få opptil 25 cm til.

advice: Les det lokale skredvarselet før du kjører utenfor løypene.
Sjekk at heisene går før du drar.
